verdict.rationale: The agent tools documentation lists "MCP server" as a tool type an agent can use: an external server for systems that are not pieces. This means Activepieces agents can plug in external MCP servers, but it is only a single brief mention. The built-in MCP server and embeddable MCP evidence covers the opposite (server) role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of how to register or configure an external MCP server (transport, auth, URL), tool discovery and selection behavior, whether this works in flows as well as agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
